description: Defines the implementation class srs_allocator_impl for SRS resource allocation in a 5G NR scheduler, including methods for slot indication and aperiodic SRS allocation, along with internal data structures for managing SRS resources and slot usage.

classes.name: srs_allocator_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the srs_allocator interface for managing SRS resource allocation in a 5G NR scheduler.

methods.name: srs_allocator_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SRS allocator with cell configuration and optional prohibit window.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Handles slot indication events to update SRS resource management.

methods.name: allocate_aperiodic_srs
methods.description: Allocates resources for aperiodic SRS based on cell resource, last SRS slot, and UE configuration.

methods.name: alloc_srs_resource
methods.description: Checks and sets SRS resource usage for a given slot and cell ID.

methods.name: get_slot_idx
methods.description: Returns the index of a slot within the TDD period.
